import hashlib, json
from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls, _canonicalize_args

# --- Task 2: fingerprint tests ---
tc1 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'b': 2, 'a': 1})
tc2 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'a': 1, 'b': 2})
print('tc1.fingerprint:', tc1.fingerprint)
print('tc1.id:', tc1.id)
print('tc1 == tc2 (same call, different key order):', tc1.fingerprint == tc2.fingerprint)
print('fingerprint len:', len(tc1.fingerprint), 'id len:', len(tc1.id))

# Verify expected sha256
canon = {'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1, 'b': 2}}
expected = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(canon, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
print('matches manual sha256:', tc1.fingerprint == expected)
print('id is first 8 of fingerprint:', tc1.id == tc1.fingerprint[:8])

# tuple -> list, string trim
tc3 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'k': (1,2), 's': '  hi  '})
tc4 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'k': [1,2], 's': 'hi'})
print('tuple/list + trim same fingerprint:', tc3.fingerprint == tc4.fingerprint)

# different name -> different fingerprint
tc5 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='bar', args={'a': 1, 'b': 2})
print('different name different fp:', tc1.fingerprint != tc5.fingerprint)

# bool/number preserved
tc6 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'x': True, 'y': 3.14})
print('bool/num ok:', tc6.fingerprint == ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'y': 3.14, 'x': True}).fingerprint)
print('---')

# --- Task 1: validate_input tests ---
# dict with tool_calls
r = ToolCalls.validate_input({'tool_calls': [{'name':'foo','args':{}}]})
print('dict w/ tool_calls:', r)
# single dict
r = ToolCalls.validate_input({'name':'foo','args':{'a':1}})
print('single dict:', r)
# bare list
r = ToolCalls.validate_input([{'name':'foo','args':{}},{'name':'bar','args':{}}])
print('bare list:', r)
# JSON string list
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('[{\"name\":\"foo\",\"args\":{}}]')
print('json str list:', r)
# JSON string single
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('{\"name\":\"foo\",\"args\":{}}')
print('json str single:', r)
# non-JSON string
r = ToolCalls.validate_input('not json at all')
print('non-json str:', repr(r))
print('---done---')
"

from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

# model_copy preserves fingerprint (doesn't recompute, but that's fine - it copies the value)
tc = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'a':1, 'b':2})
copied = tc.model_copy()
print('model_copy preserves fp:', copied.fingerprint == tc.fingerprint)

# deep copy
import copy
dc = copy.deepcopy(tc)
print('deepcopy preserves fp:', dc.fingerprint == tc.fingerprint)

# Edge: empty args
tc_empty = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={})
print('empty args fp:', tc_empty.fingerprint, 'id:', tc_empty.id)

# Edge: nested dict + tuple + string with whitespace
tc_nested = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='t', args={'z': {'b': '  x  ', 'a': (1, 2, 3)}, 'flag': True, 'num': 42})
tc_nested2 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='t', args={'flag': True, 'num': 42, 'z': {'a': [1, 2, 3], 'b': 'x'}})
print('nested canonicalize equal:', tc_nested.fingerprint == tc_nested2.fingerprint)

# Verify the actual canonical serialized string
import hashlib, json
canon = {'name': 't', 'args': {'flag': True, 'num': 42, 'z': {'a': [1,2,3], 'b': 'x'}}}
expected = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(canon, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
print('matches manual:', tc_nested.fingerprint == expected)

# ToolCall with extra keys passed should be fine (pydantic ignores extra by default)
tc_extra = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'a':1}, fingerprint='IGNORED', id='IGNORED')
print('extra keys ignored, fp computed:', tc_extra.fingerprint == ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'a':1}).fingerprint)

print('ALL EDGE CASES PASS')
"
